newsitem.title: USA: Grupo Sidek says liquidation could be sought.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Sidek says liquidation could be sought.

text.p: Grupo Sidek SA de CV said Friday that as a result of its 2.43 billion peso losses for 1996, it has posted negative majority stockholders' equity, and as a result, it said that under Mexican law any interested party could request the liquidation of Sidek through judicial proceedings in Mexico.
In a statement the Guadalajara, Mexico,-based resorts, hotels and steel group said that its unit, Grupo Situr SA de CV, had similarly posted negative majority stockholders' equity.
Sidek said that a new management, in a review of the company's operations, had found "significant accounting and other irregularities" of the company's previous management.
The new management has moved to centralize all the company's accounting operations, it said.
It said the management has directed examiners to investigate the findings of irregularities.
The Sidek board received on March 3 a report prepared by Sidek's statutory examiners and directed management to take "all necessary and appropriate action" to remedy the situation, it said.
In addition, the board has called a shareholders' meeting for April 8 to provide shareholders of Sidek with a detailed report on the situation, it said.
Grupo Sidek is engaged through its subsidiaries Grupo Situr and Grupo Simec SA de CV in two primary lines of business.

Situr is a developer of integrated resorts and is a hotel owner and operator. Simec is a mini-mill steel company that produces a broad range of non-flat structural steel products. It also produces extruded aluminum products.
